name: Worldz X-SAVE™
tagline: Launch with XRP. Build on Solana. Prove across Worldz.
purpose: A dedicated XRP-to-Solana launch rail where Solana launch tokens use canonical wXRP as the quote asset while XRP-native builders retain a clear path to XRPL-native issuance and markets.

positioning.differentiator: Dedicated XRP-Solana launch economy: wXRP-native price discovery, dual-wallet onboarding, creator/referrer fee receipts in the XRP-linked quote asset, XRPL project passporting, Worldz Proof, white-label integrations and transparent MagicFee economics.

xrpBuilderExperience: Connect XRPL wallet plus Solana wallet under one X-SAVE identity.
Choose an XRP-denominated starting price and migration threshold.
Launch a Solana token whose primary quote asset is canonical wXRP.
Receive creator fee revenue in the collected wXRP quote asset where the venue supports the modeled route.
Optionally register a native XRPL token/issuer and market under the same Worldz project identity.
Use Worldz Proof to show exactly which chain, mint/issuer, pool/AMM and fee rules belong to the project.
solanaBuilderExperience: Reach XRP liquidity and XRP communities without pretending the project is native XRPL.
Price and graduate in wXRP rather than requiring SOL as the primary quote asset.
Use Jupiter/Meteora compatible Solana market infrastructure.
Gain access to X-SAVE referral partners, XRP communities and XRPL-native project discovery.

features.xSavePair: TOKEN/wXRP launch and graduated liquidity pair on Solana.
features.xSavePassport: One Worldz project identity linking verified Solana mint, XRPL issuer/token identity, domains, socials and proof records without claiming cross-chain fungibility.
features.xSaveTwinRail: Optional separate native XRPL market plus Solana wXRP market under one project dashboard. Assets are not represented as fungible across chains unless a separately audited bridge/mint-burn controller proves that property.
features.xSaveBridgePort: Discovery/integration surface for approved external XRP<->wXRP wrapping/bridge providers. Worldz does not custody XRP or mint wXRP.
features.xSavePartnerRail: API/SDK/white-label launch integration. A partner launchpad can be the 17% Worldz referrer rather than being displaced by Worldz.
features.xSaveProof: Worldz Proof receipt covering canonical wXRP mint, token mint/issuer, venue, fees, liquidity protection and transaction IDs.
features.xSaveFeed: Dedicated New / Trending / Graduating / Verified XRP-paired launch discovery.
features.xSaveTerminal: One dashboard for wXRP balance, XRP-linked launch markets, creator receipts, referral receipts and project proof.

xrplNativeRail.warning: XRPL AMM trading fees accrue to AMM liquidity and can be changed by LP-weighted fee voting. They are not equivalent to the Solana DBC creator/partner fee router.

builderReasons: XRP-denominated token launches on Solana instead of forcing builders to acquire SOL as their market quote asset.
Creator revenue can accrue in wXRP, keeping economics connected to the XRP ecosystem.
Referrers and partner launchpads can earn 17% of Worldz-controlled revenue.
One integration can expose a project to XRP and Solana communities.
Worldz handles launch configuration, liquidity migration, proof and disclosure instead of making each XRP developer rebuild Solana launch infrastructure.
XRPL developers keep an XRPL-native CLOB/AMM path rather than being told to abandon their native ledger.
Solana developers receive a dedicated XRP-liquidity discovery lane rather than a generic custom-pair checkbox.
Worldz Proof makes cross-chain identity explicit and prevents fake copycat mints/issuers from being silently treated as canonical.
mainnetGates: Reverify canonical wXRP Solana mint and decimals from multiple authoritative/major ecosystem sources.
Prove Meteora DBC accepts the selected wXRP quote mint and required TokenBadge/permission configuration.
Prove 75-bps launch and migrated-pool fee behavior with quote-only fee collection.
Prove creator/partner receipts and Worldz 17/15/8.5/8.5 partner routing.
Prove Jupiter buy and sell routing after graduation.
Prove dual-wallet attribution without custodial access to either wallet.
Prove XRPL Passport registration does not imply fungibility or bridging.
Complete bridge/custodian risk disclosure and integration review.
